mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board_notice WHERE use_yn = 'Y'

SELECT notice_seq as noticeSeq, notice_type as noticeType, notice_title as noticeTitle, notice_content as noticeContent, DATE_FORMAT(n.create_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') as createDt, notice_view as noticeView FROM board_notice n LEFT JOIN member m ON n.member_seq = m.member_seq WHERE use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY notice_seq DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT b.notice_seq as noticeSeq, b.notice_type as noticeType, b.notice_title as noticeTitle, b.notice_content as noticeContent, m.member_name as writerName, DATE_FORMAT(b.create_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') as createDt, b.notice_view as noticeView, f.file_id as fileId, f.file_name as boardFileName, f.file_etx as boardFileEtx, f.board_file as boardFile FROM board_notice b LEFT JOIN member m ON b.member_seq = m.member_seq LEFT JOIN board_file f ON b.notice_seq = f.board_seq WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND (f.board_type is null or f.board_type = 'notice') AND b.notice_seq = #{noticeId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board_notice WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND notice_seq = #{noticeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD_NOTICE ( notice_type, notice_title, notice_content, member_seq ) VALUES ( #{noticeType}, #{noticeTitle}, #{noticeContent}, #{memberSeq} )
INSERT INTO board_file ( board_type, board_seq, file_name, file_etx, board_file, create_dt ) VALUES ( #{boardType}, #{boardSeq}, #{boardFileName}, #{boardFileEtx}, #{boardFile}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE board_notice SET notice_type = #{noticeType}, notice_title = #{noticeTitle}, notice_content = #{noticeContent}, member_seq = #{memberSeq}, update_dt = NOW() WHERE notice_seq = #{noticeSeq}
UPDATE board_file SET file_name = #{boardFileName}, file_etx = #{boardFileEtx}, board_file = #{boardFile}, update_dt = NOW() WHERE board_type = #{boardType} AND board_seq = #{boardSeq}
